svg.title: Fig. 205(d) — French horn
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 205(d), page 231. Section: trigonometric.

g.data-text: The mean level (the straight line); the wave swings about it.
The wave: the 6th harmonic whose amplitude jumps up once per period and then dies away — a sum of harmonics 1 to 12 — over three periods.
